title: Navy Blue Account: Interest Explained
summary: Explains Navy Blue Account interest: APY on your balance is 0.5%, compounded daily. Interest starts accruing when funds are available, and accrued/credited interest appears in account activity and monthly statements. The 0.5% APY may change per account terms and prevailing conditions.
faqs: What is the Navy Blue Account APY for my balance?
How is interest calculated (is it compounded and how often)?
When does interest begin accruing after I deposit funds?
Where can I view accrued and credited interest (statements/activity)?
Can the 0.5% APY change, and under what conditions?
What should I do to maximize interest earnings in this account?
